followup_analysis.verdict: News regime signal does NOT improve SMM forecasts. No gate setting yields a significant CRPS gain on m0_w3 or m0_conformal; median-shift on TSFM medians is directionally favorable but n.s. (t=-0.50/-1.27). Directional accuracy 0.64 is suggestive but not significant. The reader mostly abstains or reports low confidence (Canadian-heavy KB for a US series; thin 2022-2024 coverage).
